description: Get a quiz submission's state for an IN-PROGRESS (untaken) attempt, including the student's live answer and flag per question. For a SUBMITTED attempt (complete or pending_review), Canvas never returns the answer value or a real flag state through this endpoint — only grading state (correct) is available here. To review a submitted attempt's actual answer text, use get_quiz_question_responses instead.
name: get_quiz_submission_answers
title: Get Quiz Submission Answers
